# MicrosoftAzureDataManagerForEnergy.Search

```m
MicrosoftAzureDataManagerForEnergy.Search(serviceName as text, dataPartition as text, kind as text, query as text, optional limit as nullable number, optional returnedFields as nullable text) as table
```

Queries for records in the Microsoft Azure Data Manager for Energy instance

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Optional |
|---|---|---|
| `serviceName` | `text` | no |
| `dataPartition` | `text` | no |
| `kind` | `text` | no |
| `query` | `text` | no |
| `limit` | `nullable number` | yes |
| `returnedFields` | `nullable text` | yes |

## Examples (engine metadata — not verified here)

Returns a record that contains the count of records which satisfy the query, and a table of records that's been optionally limited by the limit parameter
